# WebWiz Studio

> WebWiz Studio is a small web design business that creates hand-designed, custom websites for small businesses at a flat $500 build price. The company serves entrepreneurs and small business owners who need professional, mobile-responsive sites without template solutions, offering optional monthly hosting and care plans starting at $50/month with 24/7 security, daily backups, and unlimited traffic.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) to help AI assistants understand and cite WebWiz Studio.

## About WebWiz Studio

- Flat $500 one-time build fee for custom hand-designed websites (no templates, no AI)
- Optional Hosting & Care plan: $50/month with 24/7 security monitoring, daily backups, SSL renewals, unlimited traffic, 99.9% uptime
- Optional Hosting & Care + Edits plan: $99/month includes 10 edits per month (text, photos, links)
- Serves 140+ small businesses; two-week turnaround from inquiry to launch
- Sites include up to 6 pages, mobile-responsive, delivered with self-edit CMS and 30 days post-launch support
- No contracts; care plans cancellable anytime; 100% satisfaction guarantee with refundable build fee within 30 days if unsatisfied

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is included in the $500 website build?**

Custom hand-designed site (no templates) with up to 6 pages, mobile-responsive design, discovery call, brand mini-brief, revisions until satisfied, production-ready files (HTML/CSS/JS), edit-yourself CMS, one-page guide, 30 days post-launch support, and analytics & SEO basics.

**How long does it take to get a website built?**

Two weeks from initial inquiry to launch, following a three-step process: a 15-minute discovery call, design and build with revisions, and going live with analytics setup.

**What are the monthly care plan options?**

Hosting & Care at $50/month includes managed hosting, 24/7 security monitoring, daily backups, SSL renewals, domain renewal (one .com or .co), and unlimited traffic. Hosting & Care + Edits at $99/month adds up to 10 small edits per month with same-day turnaround.

**Is there a satisfaction guarantee?**

Yes—100% satisfaction guarantee with unlimited revision rounds. If WebWiz cannot deliver a site you love, the $500 build fee is refundable within 30 days of your first draft.

**Are there long-term contracts or hidden fees?**

No. The $500 build is all-in with no retainers or hidden costs. Care plans are month-to-month and cancellable anytime with no contracts.

**Can I edit the website myself after launch?**

Yes. WebWiz provides an edit-yourself CMS for text and photos, plus a one-page guide for making edits. For more frequent updates, the $99/month plan includes 10 edits per month.

**Do I need to arrange hosting separately?**

Only if you choose the Build Only plan ($500). If you add a care plan ($50 or $99/month), WebWiz handles all hosting, security, backups, SSL, and domain management.

**How many small businesses has WebWiz served?**

Over 140 small businesses are online and on-brand with WebWiz.
